notes.title: version 2.00 (updated September 21, 2024)
notes.content:
Added a Casual Mode because the difficulty level was too high.

Difference by mode
The conventional game is the standard mode, and the newly added mode is the casual mode.
In Casual Mode, a checkpoint is added at the beginning of each level, and falling spheres return to the checkpoint.
The sphere color changes will be released as a reward for clearing the game in Standard Mode.

Changing the mode
Press “New Game” on the title screen to start the game in Standard Mode. Press the ESC key during game play to change to casual mode from the pause screen that appears. You can only change from Standard Mode to Casual Mode. Once you change to Casual Mode, you cannot change back to Standard Mode unless you initialize your progress.

<Details>
Casual mode has been added.
The sphere color change has been added as a reward for clearing the game in Standard Mode.
The height limit of some keyboards has been adjusted.
The direction when falling was adjusted.
The difficulty level of special stages has been eased by increasing the power of the keys.
UI has been adjusted/added along with various updates.
